policy: All 128 measured diagnostic requests retained; 24 warmup/settling requests excluded as declared. No quiet admission, selective removal, release throughput claim or promotion. Payload vectors and raw native telemetry stay private.
decode_rate_definition: 255 decoded steps / native decode_seconds; excludes first sample. Native prefill_seconds is time to first sample, including model prefill and initial sampling.

machine_conditions.weight_guard: Prior full hashes; size, mtime_ns and inode revalidated before/after each run. No new full payload hashing claim.

clock_sampler.policy: Rootless IOReport GPU performance-state residency, active-time-weighted MHz; conservative source-read brackets, fully contained intervals only. Decode joins approximate client start + native prefill. SMC reported GPU temperature is sensor average, not hottest junction. No privileged powermetrics cross-check or limiter-reason flag.

telemetry_grid_contract.policy: One worker at a time; CPU aggregate profiling without GPU stage timestamp writes. Same 512/256 input/output workload, seed42 and two MTP drafts. All measurements retained; no quiet-admission or promotion claim.

clock_probe.policy: Fixed rest before each group; subsequent requests retain the ordinary 0.6s host-screen interval. No quiet admission or selective removal. Same loaded worker, input, seed and MTP route throughout.

execution_profile.configuration_flags_semantics: Known selector environment values, including inactive selectors; not dispatch proof.
execution_profile.recipe_wrapper_binding: Source hash only; invocation is not observed.
